---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose a new feature or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? What are you trying to do that is currently difficult or impossible?

## Proposed solution

Describe the approach. If you have multiple alternatives, list them.

## Alternatives considered

What other ways could this be solved? Why is the proposed solution better?

## Scope

- Affected area: API / Web UI / Deployment / Documentation
- Breaking change: yes / no
- Requires migration: yes / no
